newsitem.title: CHINA: China's B share markets end mixed on consolidation.
newsitem.headline: China's B share markets end mixed on consolidation.

text.p: China's B share indices closed mixed on Tuesday on consolidation following gains in the past two days and amid investors' concerns about 1996 company results, brokers said.
The Shanghai B index edged down 0.698 points, or 1.10 percent, to 62.656 while the Shenzhen B index gained 0.55 points, or 0.38 percent, to 145.78.
Shanghai brokers said most investors had no interest in buying given the expectation of poor results for most firms on the Shanghai Stock Exchange.
"Domestic investors were also busy with the re-registration of B share trading accounts ordered by the securities authorities," one broker said.
Sanmao Textile was the biggest loser on expectations of poor 1996 results, falling $0.014, or 6.25 percent, to $0.210 on volume of 210,000 shares.
Tientsin Marine Shipping was the most active share on profit-taking, dipping $0.008, or 1.68 percent, to $0.468 on volume of 2.3 million shares.

Shenzhen's B share market rose for the third session in a row, but most institutions remained cautious about buying ahead of the forthcoming Chinese lunar new year holiday and the annual corporate report season, brokers said.
Watch maker Fiyta climbed HK$0.20, or 3.64 percent, to HK$5.70 on volume of 281,480 shares.
Gujing Distillery, the most active counter, edged up HK$0.04 to HK$10.64 on trade of 1.06 million shares due to investor confidence in the company's earnings outlook, brokers said.

The A share markets reversed early gains with sentiment cautious, with Shanghai's A index falling 4.157 points, or 0.43 percent, to 969.989 and Shenzhen's A index down 0.95 points, or 0.27 percent, at 350.21.

In Shanghai, Chengdu People Store's A share was the biggest loser, falling 0.59 yuan, or 4.50 percent, to 12.51 on volume of 847,400 shares. In Shenzhen, Changchun High-tech was the worst A share performer. It slid 0.79 yuan, or 3.17 percent, to 24.10 yuan.
Newcomer garment maker Fareast Industrial Stock ended the session at 14.76 yuan against a recent offer price of 5.30 yuan per share.

Another new listing, computer parts maker Yantai Dongfang Electronics, whose 10.30 million A shares and 6.90 million staff shares were floated in Shenzhen on Tuesday, closed the session at 17.24 yuan.
The A shares were offered at 7.88 yuan each last month while the staff shares were issued at 1.60 yuan each in 1993.
